shortDefinition: A packaged integration that adds new capabilities to an AI model or chatbot.
fullDefinition: A plugin is a pre-built integration that extends an AI model's capabilities by giving it access to a specific external service or tool. ChatGPT pioneered the plugin ecosystem (now called GPT Actions). Plugins typically involve a set of defined functions the AI can call, plus authentication to the external service. The concept overlaps with 'skills' (Microsoft) and 'tools' (general API terminology).
